# The Reference and its replacement variants (generated by tools/replacement_scenarios.py)

Current defaults, 2026 overbuild rule `market_excess`; only the replacement variant changes. Net replacement = demolition (0.135%/yr, BRANZ SR214) + residual. Long run 1991-2023: 0.101%/yr (residual -0.034%, i.e. net unconsented additions); 2018-2023 interval: 0.312%/yr. Stock end-2025: 2,107,606 dwellings.

## Against the 2026 overbuild (reported, NOT fitted)

O = observed-implied 2026 completions (all categories, nowcast consents); R = the variant's 2026 requirement before the overbuild; the excess O - R is the 2026 overbuild. Share of the Low excess = how much of it the variant's own replacement requirement covers.
